{"metadata":{"description":"Caddy-fronted administrator authentication for DeepSeek Harness: Argon2id, revocable sessions, bilingual UI, zero upstream forks.","id":"gh:1334219416","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-auth","slug":"hxy91819/dsh-auth","topics":["argon2id","authentication","caddy","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-category-security","dsh-plugin","dsh-security","npm-package"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Caddy-fronted administrator authentication for DeepSeek Harness: Argon2id, revocable sessions, bilin"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"gual UI, zero upstream forks."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-auth"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Unofficial community plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Add a secure administrator login to the DeepSeek H"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"arness Web app. `dsh-auth` keeps Harness on loopback and installs a project-owned Caddy `forward_aut"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"h` edge for pages, APIs, downloads, SSE, and WebSockets."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Version 0.2.0 is a breaking upgrade from legacy v1 deployments. Previous installer flags, Nginx-mana"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ged installations, and old sessions are not migrated. Uninstall the previous installation, then run "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ons, and old sessions are not migrated. Uninstall the previous installation, then run `setup` again."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Interactive setup"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Install the published CLI, then start from an existing DSH Web systemd service whose upstream listen"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ed CLI, then start from an existing DSH Web systemd service whose upstream listens only on loopback:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"`npm install -g dsh-auth` installs the current stable CLI, and the installer pins that same version "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"in the selected DSH profile. For controlled production rollout, install the exact version approved b"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"y your supply-chain policy:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Plugin pre-install is not enabled authentication"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-auth` (or a local tarball) only adds the bundle to the Web profile"},{"id":"p13s2","text":". With both core environment variables absent the bundle stays dormant: Web keeps booting with its n"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ative authentication, and no dsh-auth routes or settings UI appear. A partially supplied configurati"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"on produces an activation error and does not enable dsh-auth; Harness may keep running with its nati"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ve authentication. Enabling authentication always requires the globally installed CLI and `sudo dsh-"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"auth setup`; the plugin command never creates secrets, installs Caddy, or protects anything."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"When setup finds a pre-installed bundle whose package name, version, and build content exactly match"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" the running CLI, it adopts it: no package is reinstalled, and the bundle keeps external ownership. "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"Any other pre-installed build is refused before the host changes. Rollback and uninstall leave an ad"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"opted bundle in place; without managed configuration it simply returns to dormancy."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The interactive installer asks for the exact DSH service, administrator initialization method, HTTPS"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" hostname, and TLS mode; shows a secret-free plan; and changes the system only after you type the ex"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"act confirmation. It installs the pinned bundle into the selected DSH profile, copies a checksum-ver"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ified Caddy binary bundled in the same package, writes permission-restricted authentication state, a"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"nd enables an independent `dsh-auth-caddy.service`. It never stores a plaintext password and never d"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ownloads Caddy at setup time."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Normal deployment requires Linux x64 or ARM64, systemd, Node.js 24.7 or newer, and DSH Web 0.2.0-rc."},{"id":"p16s2","text":"2. Automatic TLS is the HTTPS default. Manual TLS requires an existing certificate and key. `--serve"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"r-name` accepts either a DNS name or a public literal IP address."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### CLI setup (non-interactive)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Non-interactive mode requires stable flags and an explicit administrator initialization method. For "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"password initialization, mount the plaintext password as a temporary `0600` secret file supplied by "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"the platform; `dsh-auth` reads it once to create an Argon2id hash and does not copy the plaintext."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"These command names, flag names, `--name value` or `--name=value` syntax, JSON schema version 2, and"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" exit codes are the public automation contract. Global flags may precede the command. New flags and "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"diagnostic codes may be added. Renaming, removing, or changing the meaning of an existing flag, JSON"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" field, or exit code is a breaking change."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Print the frozen usage text:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`-h` is an alias for `--help`. `dsh-auth setup --help` prints the same usage text. The example below"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" is a complete HTTPS system install with password initialization and automatic TLS."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Prompts run only when stdin and stdout are both TTYs and `--non-interactive` is not set. `--json` is"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" output format only and does not disable prompts."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Token initialization omits the password and username. The first authorized user sets them in the bro"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"wser, or chooses Later:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Flag | Required | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| `--help`, `-h` | no | | Print usage and exit. |
| `--version` | no | | Print the CLI version and e"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"xit. |
| `--non-interactive` | on a TTY | | Disable prompts. |
| `--json` | no | | Emit one JSON doc"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ument. Does not disable prompts. |
| `--mode` | no | `https` | `https` or `http`. |
| `--behind-tls-"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"proxy` | no | disabled | Keep the managed HTTP edge on loopback, require trusted HTTPS forwarding he"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"aders, and issue Secure cookies. |
| `--admin-bootstrap` | when not prompting | | `password` or `log"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"in-token`. |
| `--admin-username` | password setup | | Initial administrator login name. |
| `--logi"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"n-token` | when not prompting | | `enabled` or `disabled`. Token initialization requires `enabled`. "},{"id":"p29s8","text":" when not prompting | | `enabled` or `disabled`. Token initialization requires `enabled`. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Security behavior and limits"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- Production cookies are `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Lax`, `Path=/`, and `__Host-` prefixed. Pla"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"in HTTP uses an explicit compatibility cookie mode.
- Argon2id hashes and random session secrets liv"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"e in separate permission-restricted files. Persistent opaque sessions use a `0600` authentication-st"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"ate document.
- Login, logout, token redemption, and first-time administrator setup enforce CSRF plu"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"s exact Origin/Referer checks after trusted-proxy resolution. Authentication responses are `no-store"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"`.
- Version 2 supports one administrator identity (`admin`) per managed installation. Password and "},{"id":"p31s7","text":"token initialization are an explicit choice. Registration, self-service account recovery, MFA, datab"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"ases, multi-account policy, and multi-tenancy are outside this release.
- The managed dsh-auth Caddy"},{"id":"p31s9","text":" is the only authentication edge allowed to reach Harness. It is normally the public listener; with "},{"id":"p31s10","text":"`--behind-tls-proxy`, an operator-owned proxy is public but may reach only the managed edge. A stand"},{"id":"p31s11","text":"ard reverse proxy cannot immediately revoke an already-open WebSocket. Deployments requiring immedia"},{"id":"p31s12","text":"te stream termination need a connection-aware edge."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Security reports follow `SECURITY.md`."}],"truncated":true}
